curriculumCourses.title: Course 101: Essentials of Metabolism and Theories of Aging
curriculumCourses.focus: Cellular metabolism, mitochondrial function, free radicals, antioxidants, theories of biological aging, cellular senescence.

curriculumCourses.title: Course 102: Nutritional Medicine in Neurology
curriculumCourses.focus: Neurodegenerative disorders, cognitive health, neurotransmitters, blood-brain barrier, brain development.

curriculumCourses.title: Course 103: Nutritional Medicine In Metabolic Diseases
curriculumCourses.focus: Insulin resistance, Type 2 diabetes, metabolic syndrome, dyslipidemia, cardiovascular risk biomarkers.

curriculumCourses.title: Course 104: Nutritional Medicine in Systemic Health Problems
curriculumCourses.focus: Autoimmune conditions, chronic inflammation, musculoskeletal disorders, immune system optimization.

curriculumCourses.title: Course 105: Nutritional Medicine in Reproductive Health, Weight Management and Sports Nutrition
curriculumCourses.focus: Hormonal balance, athletic performance, body composition, ergogenic aids, sports supplementation.

curriculumCourses.title: Course 106: Nutritional Medicine in Cancer, Gastrointestinal Diseases and Functional Assessment
curriculumCourses.focus: Oncology nutrition support, gut microbiome, intestinal permeability, clinical nutritional assessment protocols.

curriculumCourses.title: Module 7: Clinical Case Studies and Final Practice Assignment
curriculumCourses.focus: Real-world patient case evaluations, integrative dietary protocols, orthomolecular supplementation regimens.

keyPersonnel.name: Dr. James Meschino
keyPersonnel.bio: Renowned authority in nutritional medicine, anti-aging biology, and author of comprehensive clinical nutrition curricula.

complianceRules: Distinguish clearly between established nutritional science and marketing assertions.
Do not fabricate medical cures or unsupported therapeutic claims.
Always state GIMA programs are designed specifically for licensed/regulated Healthcare Professionals.
Emphasize evidence-based clinical studies and peer-reviewed research.
